intent: A friendly myth-buster: the whole world on screen, one line across the middle, bears pinned above it, penguins below.
pacing_profile: question read verbatim, three options, 3-s beat, reveal with the number, story beats shaped per episode (brief.md), punchline + short follow
pause_policy: Pause only at the marked ellipses; the beat is real silence (ticks come from quizscore.py).
title: Polar bears and penguins have NEVER met in the wild. True or false?

lines.direction: the question, cold — curiosity comes from the map moving under it
lines.text: Polar bears and penguins have never met in the wild. True or false?

lines.direction: quick, each option its own beat
lines.text: True, False, or Only in Alaska?
True. Polar bears live only around the Arctic. Every penguin lives south of the equator, or right on it.

lines.direction: camera slides to the eastern Pacific; the Galápagos pin lands exactly on the drawn line on 'touch'; the penguin sticker pops
lines.text: The closest they come is the Galápagos, where penguins touch the equator, an ocean away from any bear.

lines.direction: the Christmas-tree sticker pops and is crossed on 'wrong'; camera swings to Alaska, the tag lands, the bear sticker pops on 'wild'
lines.text: The Christmas adverts are wrong. Alaska has polar bears, but never a wild penguin.

lines.direction: whole world again; the bear photograph slides in from the left on 'top', the penguin photograph from the right on 'bottom'
lines.text: As close as they will ever get: the top of the world, and the bottom.

lines.direction: punchline, then a short follow — the outro visual asks
lines.text: Never met. Never will. Follow us.
